arguments.sql: SELECT CAST(strftime('%H', date) AS INTEGER) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions in each hour of the day, from hour 0 to hour 23, using the transaction timestamp.
assumptions: Counts cover all transactions regardless of whether they have a fraud label, since the question asks for total transactions.
Hour is taken from the transaction timestamp as stored (no timezone conversion).
Hours with no transactions would not appear as rows; all 24 hours are expected to have data across Jan–Oct 2019.
